================================================

Dutch Formal Methods Day 2025

Amsterdam, Thursday 26 June

CALL FOR PARTICIPATION

https://conf.researchr.org/home/dfdm-2025
================================================

The Dutch Formal Methods Day is a full-day event dedicated to formal methods in the Netherlands. This event is an opportunity for people in academia, industry, and education who are interested in formal methods, in the broadest sense, to come together, learn, and network. There will be numerous talks, giving a broad overview formal methods in the Netherlands. Upon registering, you will have the opportunity to offer a talk.

Coffee and lunch will be provided; there will be ample opportunity for networking with your colleagues and meeting new people. Experts and newcomers to the field are equally welcome.

All the talks will be given in English.

Registration

Participation is free of charge, but registration is required using the link below:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScK6BhsEfbOCmJEahRIsGISiEhNYZFpM8wJgjeTuck5-FFjPA/viewform?usp=dialog

There is a soft registration deadline of Friday June 20th, 2024.

Schedule

You will find a preliminary schedule on the website:

https://conf.researchr.org/home/dfdm-2025

Details will be added as speakers become known.

Location

The Dutch Formal Methods Day will take place in Lab42 at Amsterdam Science Park. Science Park has a train station, and is a short train ride from Amsterdam Central Station. More details on how to reach science park can be found here:

https://www.amsterdamsciencepark.nl/contact/getting-there/

Organisers

@Johan Commelin

@Andrés Goens

Ronald de Haan

Benno van den Berg

A reminder that this is happening in less than two weeks! We have a great set of talks lined up (the preliminary program is at https://conf.researchr.org/home/dfdm-2025).

There's no registration or participation fees, we just ask that you register at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScK6BhsEfbOCmJEahRIsGISiEhNYZFpM8wJgjeTuck5-FFjPA/viewform?usp=dialog

Looking forward to seeing many of you here in Amsterdam on June 26!
